relationships.subject: HMGB1
relationships.evidence_quote: blockade of HMGB1 with either glycyrrhizic acid (GZA) or anti-HMGB1 antibody in PSNL mice reduced hippocampal microglia activation and ameliorated cognitive impairment

relationships.subject: anti-HMGB1 antibody
relationships.evidence_quote: decreased α-amino-3-hydroxy-5-methyl-4-isoxazolepropionic acid (AMPA) glutamate receptor (AMPAR) subunits, were prevented with anti-HMGB1 antibody treatment

key_findings: PSNL mice develop cognitive impairment at two weeks with hippocampal microglial activation and increased extracellular HMGB1; blocking HMGB1 or microglia ameliorates it.
